verdict.rationale: DOR publishes plain-language, step-by-step walkthroughs written for non-lawyers. For licensing, it covers the wizard, My DOR account setup, what a UBI is and why you need it, and online vs. mail processing times. For filing excise returns, it gives click-level instructions (add deductions, select location codes, request penalty waivers, pay by ACH, print confirmation, amend) and offers free workshops and webinars. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that founders find these explainers usable; plain-language help for choosing a B&O tax classification beyond a rate list.
